bundle.shortDescription: Host baseline security reviews - read-only scans, sealed reports.
bundle.longDescription: HBS Console runs the offline-first host baseline security review dashboard on your machine and keeps it one click away: tray icon, desktop shortcut, launch-at-login (optional) and a native window for the console. Scans stay read-only and reports stay sealed; the same dashboard is always reachable in a browser.
